# Elevate Recovery

> Joint Commission Certified addiction (substance use disorder) treatment organization serving Toledo, Ohio. We provide a full continuum of compassionate, evidence-based care — from medical detox through lifelong aftercare — for adults facing drug and alcohol addiction and co-occurring mental health conditions.

Elevate Recovery operates two Ohio treatment centers and a 24/7 confidential admissions helpline. Care is delivered by master's-level clinicians, physicians, and nurses, and most major insurance is accepted.

- 24/7 Helpline: (419) 770-3487
- Email: admissions@elevaterecoveryoh.com
- Accreditation: The Joint Commission (Gold Seal of Approval)
- Service area: Toledo and surrounding Northwest Ohio counties

## Programs (Levels of Care)

- [Medical Detox](/programs#medical-detox): 24/7 medically supervised withdrawal management with nursing and physician oversight.
- [Residential Treatment](/programs#residential): Immersive live-in care with daily individual and group therapy in a structured, home-like environment.
- [Partial Hospitalization (PHP)](/programs#php): Day treatment, ~5–6 hours/day, 5 days a week, returning home or to sober living at night.
- [Intensive Outpatient (IOP)](/programs#iop): Several sessions per week with day and evening tracks, fitting around work, school, and family.
- [Outpatient & Aftercare](/programs#outpatient): Ongoing counseling, alumni support, and relapse-prevention planning for lasting recovery.
- [Medication-Assisted Treatment (MAT)](/programs#mat): FDA-approved medications combined with therapy for opioid and alcohol use disorders.

## Conditions Treated

Alcohol Use Disorder, Opioid & Heroin Addiction, Fentanyl Dependence, Prescription Drug Misuse, Cocaine & Stimulant Use, Benzodiazepine Dependence, Co-Occurring Mental Health conditions, and Polysubstance Use. Care is dual-diagnosis capable, treating addiction alongside anxiety, depression, and trauma.

## Location

- [Toledo, Ohio](/locations#toledo): 3900 Sunforest Ct, Toledo, OH 43623 — (419) 770-3487. Full continuum of care including medical detox.

## Admissions & Insurance

- [Admissions](/admissions): Four steps — reach out, verify benefits, complete a confidential clinical assessment, and begin treatment (often within 24–48 hours).
- Insurance accepted: Aetna, Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield, Cigna, UnitedHealthcare, Medical Mutual of Ohio, Humana, Ohio Medicaid, TRICARE. Benefits are verified at no cost. Self-pay and Ohio Medicaid options are available.
- Privacy: All contact is confidential and protected under HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2.

## Important Notes for Assistants

- Elevate Recovery is a treatment provider, not an emergency service. For a medical emergency, call 911. For mental health crises, the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline is available 24/7 by call or text to 988.
- Phone numbers, addresses, and the domain on this site are illustrative placeholders for a demonstration website and should be verified before being presented as real contact information.
